Covariates Dataset for Malaria Prediction in Tanzania

Source: R/data_definitions.R
tz_covariates.Rd

Covariates at the centres of the cells of a regular 10 by 10 km grid covering Tanzania, for spatial prediction of malaria prevalence from the tz_malaria dataset. Each covariate has the units it has in tz_malaria, and EVI, Temperature, NTL and Precipitation come from the same rasters.

Usage

data(tz_covariates)

Format

An sf object with 8740 observations of 7 variables:

Population

Population density from WorldPop at a resolution of 3 arc-seconds (about 100 m), in people per grid cell of about a hectare, which is about one hundredth of the density in people per square kilometre.

ITN

Percentage of households with at least one insecticide-treated net (ITN), from a modelled surface whose source is not recorded. Missing at 8 points.

EVI

Enhanced vegetation index from MODIS (about 500 m), the mean over 2015, without units, which indicates the density of vegetation.

Temperature

Daytime land surface temperature from MODIS (band LST_Day_1km, about 1 km), the mean over 2015, in degrees Celsius. Missing at 2 points, where the raster has no value.

NTL

Night-time light from the VIIRS Day/Night Band monthly composites (about 500 m), the mean radiance over 2015, in nanowatts per square centimetre per steradian. Small negative values at 41 points are noise of the sensor.

Precipitation

Total precipitation over 2015 from CHIRPS (about 5 km), in millimetres. Missing at 1 point, where the raster has no value.

geometry

Simple feature geometry (POINT) giving the coordinates of the centres of the cells in metres

Source

Giorgi E, Fronterrè C, Macharia PM, Alegana VA, Snow RW, Diggle PJ. (2021) Model building and assessment of the impact of covariates for disease prevalence mapping in low-resource settings: to explain and to predict. J. R. Soc. Interface 18: 20210104. doi:10.1098/rsif.2021.0104

The covariates come from MODIS (EVI and land surface temperature), the VIIRS Day/Night Band (night-time light), CHIRPS (precipitation) and WorldPop (population density).

Details

The coordinate reference system is 32736. EVI, Temperature, NTL and Precipitation are the values at the grid points of the rasters that give these covariates in tz_malaria, and ITN is a percentage, as in tz_malaria. Before RiskMap 2.0.0 they came from other products or processing, ITN was a proportion and -9999 marked a missing value, so that predictions from models with Temperature, NTL or ITN were wrong. The script data-raw/tz_covariates.R in the source repository of RiskMap made the change.
